snippet.title: Toxic Crusaders - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Toxic Crusaders, an action beat-em-up game developed by Gamecom Team. Players will take control of one of seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and abilities. Check out the latest trailer highlighting new levels and an electrifying boss fight. Toxic Crusaserd is launching in Q3 2025 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
